gate_or_program: APPUI-COMP-01 - Kymaean Application Component System Foundation
design_axis: APP VISUAL foundational Product-independent component and interaction grammar
bounded_question: How should everyday Kymaean controls behave and look at interaction scale without reopening the frozen app architecture/static visual system or inventing unresolved Product semantics?

close_reconciliation.effect: No contradiction. Bellweather remains app-brand visual authority while the new Website mascot exploration is non-production and explicitly freezes app UI; Engineering adds no APPUI Product semantics.

controlled_inputs: Light F2 / Dark D3 role system
MAT F1 / TYP F1 / STA F2
FICON F1 for conventional platform verbs

local_result.summary: A coherent Product-independent foundational control grammar survives deterministic and visual review in Light and Dark across wide/narrow/accessibility stress.

judgment.design_sol_view: The foundation is visually Kymaean because it keeps the field/task dominant, makes controls quiet until operated, reserves teal from default action/status meaning, and keeps focus/selection structurally separate.
judgment.director_view_or_delegation: Director explicitly authorized continuation of unfinished app-interface design; Design Sol executed and closed this bounded Product-independent gate under standing design delegation.

mechanical: Seven-case matrix PASS with zero layout overflow
solid 2px focus / 2px offset in every case
invalid_or_superseded_attempts: Initial probe contrast helper failed before diagnostics and was removed as redundant harness logic; it did not change the carrier.
Initial narrow/200%-text geometry exposed min-width and switch-shrink defects; responsive-only repairs were made before final freeze without retuning frozen visual roles.

requires: KYMAEAN APPUI Phase 3 Static App Visual System 01
constrains: Later Product-independent APP VISUAL controls default to this action/input/choice/row/disclosure/transient/feedback grammar unless an explicit successor supersedes it.

known_integration_sensitivities: Primary app commands must not casually switch to teal-filled buttons.
Dense toolbars must keep FICON F1 quiet rather than adding persistent boxed icon chrome.
Real workspace panels must not multiply functional control boundaries into a card-grid identity.
High-consequence and error states require explicit language and structure rather than a future semantic-color shortcut.
explicit_non_authority: No Stage successor or behavior change.
No bespoke domain glyphs or final icon asset package.
No final font files, production tokens, WinUI/XAML mapping, shipping/package/Store authority.
No Bellweather mascot placement/implementation is created by this component-foundation packet.

director_review_surface.entry_point: wide + narrow Foundational Control Grammar 01 renders
director_review_surface.what_to_review: everyday action/input/choice/row/disclosure/transient/feedback hierarchy in Light F2 and Dark D3
